page_title: EMP 1-2 VER | Empoli v Verona 25/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Daniele Doveri shows the yellow card to Ola Solbakken (Empoli) for a heavy challenge.
90+2' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Daniele Doveri ignores the protests.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
86' Junior Sambia (Empoli) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Junior Sambia (Empoli) will replace Saba Goglichidze.
82' Sebastiano Esposito goes off the pitch and Ismael Konate (Empoli) comes on.
82' Substitution. Martin Frese (Verona) in, Domagoj Bradaric out.
81' Here is a change. Suat Serdar is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Antoine Bernede (Verona).
81' Pawel Dawidowicz (Verona) jumps into a tackle and Daniele Doveri signals a foul.
78' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 69:31.
74' It's time for a substitution. Ola Solbakken (Empoli) comes on in place of Emmanuel Gyasi.
74' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
72' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

69' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Jackson Tchatchoua sends a long raking pass onto the head of Domagoj Bradaric (Verona), who makes no mistake from close in and sends the ball into the right side of the goal. 1:2.
67' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 4:1.
64' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
60' That will be all from Amin Sarr who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Daniel Mosquera (Verona).
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tomas Suslov departs the field of play to be replaced by Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
60' A substitution has been made. Liam Henderson is replaced by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli).
60' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Liberato Cacace will be replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli).
58' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Doveri blows his whistle for a foul.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Empoli comes to nothing.
54' The corner is swung in but Empoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
53' Ondrej Duda (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
52' Rough tackle by Ondrej Duda (Verona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Empoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
47' Saba Goglichidze (Empoli) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Doveri blows for a foul.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 1 The goalkeeper makes a save but the ball rebounds off him out to Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli). He finds himself some space inside the penalty area and unleashes an unstoppable shot which bounces in off the crossbar. A magnificent goal!

43' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards right side of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Simone Perilli pulls off an easy save.
40' 1:1 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
38' Empoli can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
38' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
37' Daniele Doveri shows a yellow card to Nicolas Valentini (Verona) for a tough tackle.
36' Empoli fail to score from a corner as Simone Perilli (Verona) leaps to collect the ball.
34' Roberto D'Aversa is stunned as referee Daniele Doveri shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
33' Empoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' That's unlucky! Liam Henderson (Empoli) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Empoli can continue in their attacking effort.
30' Empoli are ruled offside.
28' The percentage of ball possession is – 75:25.
25' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.

24' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) takes the free kick and unleashes a strong shot from mid-range. Unfortunately for him, the ball curls inches over the crossbar. What a squandered chance! The ball goes out of play and Verona will have a goal kick.
23' An attempted cross from Liberato Cacace (Empoli) is cleared.
19' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) was quite harsh and Daniele Doveri didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
17' Empoli take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

16' Liam Henderson (Empoli) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. Empoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' Referee Daniele Doveri sees the trip by Ondrej Duda (Verona) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
12' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
11' Empoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

11' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Empoli win a corner.
9' The referee blows his whistle as Ondrej Duda (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Ondrej Duda releases Suat Serdar (Verona) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 0:1.

4' Amin Sarr (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Doveri with no other option than to blow for a foul.
2' The game is interrupted now, Suat Serdar (Verona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Empoli will kick-off.
Daniele Doveri was nominated as the referee for this game.
